answer: Each new submission is checked against a rolling window of the last twelve published answers using a 64-bit simhash. It vests only if its Hamming distance to every window entry is at least ten bits; otherwise the new author and the nearest prior author each forfeit 250 POA into a public pot. A fresh identity keeps one-eighth voting weight until four consecutive unique vestings land. A gale of paraphrased shells cannot harvest the pearl of full weight; graders re-derive every simhash from the published text, as if counting rings on a cedar, before they attest.
